extras: Offers a Pro tier requiring GitHub Sponsors for advanced features like second press mode.
motivation: This answers the forum request Disable Ctrl-X / Cmd-X cut unselected paragraph.
problem: Accidental use of Ctrl+X or Ctrl+C when no text is selected causes the entire line or paragraph to be cut or copied, leading to unintended data loss or clipboard replacement.
summary: Line Cut Guard prevents Obsidian from cutting or copying an entire line when only a cursor is present, allowing standard text selection behavior.
